senses.gloss: staupika, adj. and subst. (Skt. Lex., only Trik., = bauddha-dravya; to stūpa 1 plus -ika), pertaining to a stūpa; usually with parallel sāṃghika, and applied to [] property (dravya, vitta, vastu): Śikṣ 〔170.3〕; Bbh 〔166.20〕; RP 〔29.8〕; Gv 〔228.21〕; as subst., implying some such word, what belongs to a stūpa, Śikṣ 〔56.5〕; Bbh 〔163.11〕.
